exercises.question: Which sentence uses a relative clause for a place?
options: El barrio donde vivo tiene muchos parques. [The neighbourhood where I live has many parks.]
Vivo en un barrio con muchos parques. [I live in a neighbourhood with many parks.]
El barrio es grande y tiene parques. [The neighbourhood is big and has parks.]

exercises.sentence: La gente ___ conocí me ayudó mucho.
exercises.english: The people I met helped me a lot.
The neighbourhood where I live has many parks.

sentences: Conocí a mucha gente. [I met a lot of people.]
La gente que conocí me ayudó mucho. [The people I met helped me a lot.]
Por eso ahora me siento en casa. [That is why I now feel at home.]

exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: Lo que más me gusta de la ciudad es la gente. [What I like most about the city is the people.]
Que más me gusta de la ciudad es la gente. [That I like most about the city is the people.]
Donde más me gusta de la ciudad es la gente. [Where I like most about the city is the people.]

exercises.sentence: Lo ___ hace un hogar es la sensación de pertenencia.

What makes a home is the feeling of belonging.

options: What makes a home is the feeling of belonging.
